Title: Migrate projects to the Inheritance process model: VSTS Sprint 139 Update

Body.Content:
In the Sprint 139 Update of Visual Studio Team Services (VSTS), you can now migrate Hosted XML projects to the Inheritance process model to ease customization. Plus, your releases can now be triggered by a PR to help you execute additional testing before a merge.

See the following links to read about all the new features in the Sprint 139 Update:

Wiki:

  • Create table of contents for wiki pages

Work:

  • Ease customization by migrating projects to the Inheritance process model
  • Chat about the latest status using the improved Microsoft Teams integration

Code:

  • Standardize pull request descriptions using templates

Build and release:

  • Perform additional testing using a pull request release trigger
  • Deploy Go apps to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using Azure DevOps Projects

View the full release notes.
